scientific_integrity: Formal unbounded-parameter arguments are supplied; finite exhaustive checks are additional corroboration rather than an infinite proof. There has been no independent mathematical or historical priority audit.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers only single qualified counting tests with disjunction inside the test, mutually exclusive successor colours, stars of degree one to three, and at least two colours. Arbitrary concept combinations, general ALCQ, nonexclusive colours, and larger degrees are not covered. Historical priority is provisional.
title: The first online-shattering transition for one-step graded colour tests
